messages:
mira: heads-up: scheduling a staggered release tonight 23:00 UTC. services: api (v2026-03-21.1), runtime (2.3.1), router (0.9.5), console (1.12.0). aim is minimal blast radius; need final sign-off on pins and rollback triggers.

sam: quick ask 3: can we lock runtime to 2.3.1 for hosted and dedicated? last time 2.3.x had a KV eviction spike during long sessions. fallback target should be 2.2.8.

jordan: console has no schema changes. router has header-split toggle that we'll flip via canary policy. no DB migrations. sequence suggestion: api -> runtime -> router -> console.

mira: proposed canary plan: 5% for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then 100%. stagger 60s between service roll steps.

rita: rollback rules I propose: abort if any of these during a canary window:
- sustained API 5xx > 0.5% over 5m
- p50 latency increase > 75ms vs baseline for 10m
- runtime logs show OOMs or kv eviction rate > 3x baseline or > 10 uncaught exceptions/min
Also manual abort: /deploy abort <run-id>. include incident notify to on-call.

sam: add console visual regressions check (search logs for `render_error`), and alert devex on any function/tooling failures. flag quant-kernel enabled only in canary. watch tokenization and cache miss rate.

mira: locking pins: runtime:2.3.1 (fallback 2.2.8), console:1.12.0, router:0.9.5, api tag: v2026-03-21.1.

jordan: I'll add a temporary route rule to send 0% traffic to new console if error_rate > 1% (fail back to previous). will inject into canary policy.

mira: planned deploy command (via deploy-bot):
```
/deploy orchestrate 
  --services api,runtime,router,console 
  --canary 5 --canary-duration 15m 
  --staged 25,100 --stagger 60s 
  --pin runtime:2.3.1 --fallback runtime:2.2.8 
  --tag v2026-03-21.1
```

deploy-bot: scheduled orchestrated deploy (run-id: 20260321-90) by mira at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Canary plan: [5% x15m, 25% x10m, 100%]. Auto-rollback thresholds set per thread.

rita: add runbook and incident channel notifications (#incidents). include sample traces in alerts for p95 regressions.

sam: note about runtime: kernel-quant path will be enabled on canary only; watch for tokenization diffs and KV cache miss spike.

mira: starting run in ~20m. speak up to hold.

jordan: ready. monitoring hooks set, will watch header-split rollout on router.

deploy-bot: run 20260321-90: canary phase started for api and runtime. 5% traffic routed to new variants. hooks live.

mira: keeping an eye on metrics and logs. ping here for any anomalies.

rita: quick abort snippet for ops: 
```
/deploy abort 20260321-90 --reason "auto-threshold"
/deploy promote fallback --services runtime --version 2.2.8
```

sam: will record a short note for release_notes.md about console bundle tweaks and kernel-quant toggle.

mira: will update release_notes.md after completion with metrics and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
